text.tspan: Homicide rate vs. GDP per capita 2024
Homicide rate is measured as the number of intentional homicide deaths per 100,000 people. GDP per capita is
adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: UN, World Population Prospects (2024); United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (2025); Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World
To allow for comparisons between countries and over time, this metric is age-standardized. GDP per capita is expressed in

text.tspan: international-$ at 2021 prices. Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2019 and 2025 is shown instead.
